title: Canary Release Testing Checklist — Runnable Companion

description: Argo Rollouts 1.8 manifests and a Node gate evaluator implementing the stage-gate rules from the QAPractices canary release checklist: baseline deltas, absolute floors, minimum request volume and fail-closed missing data.
